summary_en: This study tests the antibiotic metronidazole and a chlorhexidine mouth rinse in people with oral cancer (squamous cell carcinoma of the mouth). The study is Phase 2 and uses one group of participants. Participants take metronidazole 500 mg three times a day and rinse with 10 mL of chlorhexidine three times a day, both for 10 days, before surgery to remove the tumor. The main goal is to measure how much these antibiotics reduce the amount of bacteria inside the tumor; a separate outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba el antibiótico metronidazol y un enjuague bucal de clorhexidina en personas con cáncer oral (carcinoma de células escamosas de la boca). El estudio es de Fase 2 y usa un solo grupo de participantes. Los participantes toman metronidazol de 500 mg tres veces al día y se enjuagan con 10 mL de clorhexidina tres veces al día, ambos durante 10 días, antes de la cirugía para extirpar el tumor. El objetivo principal es medir cuánto reducen estos antibióticos la cantidad de bacterias dentro del tumor; no se indica una medida de resultado por separado.
who_for: Pathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity
Able to understand and willing to sign written informed consent
not_for: Known allergy to metronidazole or chlorhexidine
Actively drinking alcohol and unable to stop during the 10-day antibiotic period
Recurrent oral cancer after radiation or chemoradiation, or unresectable oral cancer
Unable to use oral rinse or take metronidazole by mouth or feeding tube, took other antibiotics in the prior 30 days, or pregnant
